name: Scoring Rubric for Fly Visual Analysis
description: Qualitative scoring criteria for evaluating AI responses to visual analysis of fly illustration. Focuses on paradox of calm within chaos, flies as integral elements, and text integration.
scoring_philosophy: We value perception of visual paradox, understanding of elements as integral rather than disruptive, and analysis of text placement as thematic.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Does the AI understand the visual paradox of relaxed figure surrounded by chaotic elements?

levels.description: AI provides nuanced analysis of visual paradox, understands tension between pose and environment, and interprets this as thematic statement about perspective.
AI identifies paradoxical elements and provides reasonable interpretation.
AI notices some tension but analysis is superficial or misses key dynamics.
AI treats figure and environment as unrelated or fails to recognize paradox.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Can the AI perceive flies as natural parts of composition rather than intrusions?

levels.description: AI perceptively identifies flies as integral, understands their visual distribution as creating 'buzzing' effect, and connects to themes of belonging.
AI recognizes flies as part of composition and provides reasonable interpretation.
AI shows limited awareness of flies' integration.
AI treats flies as decorative or disruptive without understanding their role.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Does the AI understand the significance of text placement and its visual context?

levels.description: AI provides insightful analysis of text integration, understands bottom-right placement as grounding, and connects handwritten quality to themes of layering and imperfection.
AI recognizes text integration and provides reasonable interpretation.
AI notices text but analysis is superficial.
AI treats text as separate caption or misinterprets its function.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Can the AI work with the concept of absence (dvorek, bordeláři, proces) and presence (žena, mouchy, text) in illustration?

levels.description: AI creatively interprets absent-presence dynamics, understands implications of what's not shown, and analyzes selective representation as emphasis on state over event.
AI recognizes absent-presence and provides adequate analysis.
AI shows limited understanding of absent-presence concept.
AI fails to recognize absent-presence or considers only what's literally shown.

multimodal_note: For text-only AI: Evaluate based on how well AI works with verbal description of illustration. Does it reconstruct paradoxical calm from description? Does it ask clarifying questions about visual integration?
overall_assessment_guidance: The fly illustration particularly tests understanding of visual paradox and integration. Reward AI that perceives these complex visual relationships.
note: Visual analysis of this illustration requires moving beyond literal depiction to understanding paradoxical and integral statements in visual form.
